_readme: Template only. Copy to mmdet_training.json in this folder, fill it in and delete the '_example' line; the main_*.py scripts refuse to run a config that still has it. Step 4 (main_train_mmdet.py). The detection configs include it, so that an mmdet_sahi model there can name one of these training runs.

mmdet_training._readme: Settings for main_train_mmdet.py; the keys here are shared by every model, and a model's own keys win. python = an env with mmdet (training runs in a worker on it). data_root = a COCO export of the YOLO dataset; train_ann / val_ann are relative to it (val is also used as the test split during training), img_prefix = the images folder in it. classes = the class names (num_classes is set from them). The run is written to <output_dir>/training/<wandb_project>/<run name>/ (_2, _3, ... if that name exists) and logs to W&B under wandb_project / wandb_group / run name. epochs = training length. schedule = 'recipe' keeps the recipe's LR schedulers and stage switches, with epoch milestones and switch epochs stretched from the recipe's length to epochs (iteration-based warmup unchanged), or 'warmup_cosine' (1000-iteration warmup, then cosine to 0). seed = fixed seed, null = random. Checkpoints: every epoch, keeping the latest max_keep_ckpts plus best_coco_fitness_epoch_N.pth, the best by 0.1 mAP50 + 0.9 mAP50-95 (Ultralytics fitness). log_interval = iterations between log lines.

models._readme: One entry per model, picked with --model. recipe = the upstream mmdet config. repo = the mmdet source checkout to import (the rtdetr-mmdet fork for RT-DETR). load_from = pretrained weights for the whole detector, or backbone_pretrained = weights for the backbone only. custom_imports = modules the recipe needs imported. batch_size / val_batch_size = per-GPU batch, null = the recipe's. accumulative_counts = gradient accumulation steps. The LR is scaled linearly from the recipe's total batch (auto_scale_lr.base_batch_size, e.g. 16 for an 8xb2 recipe) to batch_size x accumulative_counts, so matching that total keeps the recipe's LR. amp = mixed precision. gpu = GPU index as nvidia-smi numbers it. run_name = run folder and W&B run name.
